title: Big, and How an Adjective Agrees
label: ch:mr-the-adjective
canDo: I can call a thing big in all three genders, and I can say where a Marathi adjective stands both when it labels a noun and when it is the claim of the sentence.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R49-big and describe a thing three ways -- label a big room, claim that your house is big, and say that you have a big house -- with one adjective doing all three.
payoff.note: SPINE-DESCRIBE-QUALITIES is an A1 core node this track had never realized: forty-eight chapters could name a house and say nothing about what it was like.
